user.title: Add scene state
user.description: Create a binary sensor that is on while all entities in the scene match the scene.

data_description.entity_id: A scene defined in Home Assistant. Scenes from other integrations are not supported.
data_description.name: Leave blank to name the helper after the scene. Set a name to run more than one helper on the same scene.
data_description.grace_period: Time to wait after the scene is activated before the members are compared.
data_description.debounce: Time to wait after a member changes before the members are compared.

domain.title: Compared attributes
domain.description: Pick the attributes that must match. An attribute that you clear is ignored, whatever its value.

tolerances.title: Tolerances
tolerances.description: A value of 0 demands an exact match. Each tolerance uses the scale of the attribute itself. Measured difference right now: {measured}.
